description: This source file implements utility functions for the Slap Sco Collection Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes the creation function for the collection object, primarily providing the 'SlapCreateScoCollection' function which calls 'SlapScoColCreate'. It also contains licensing information and module metadata.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapCreateScoCollection(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new Slap Sco Collection object using the provided container, owner, and reserved handles.
